title: Dash: remove the 'suspend delivery' button
symptom: The issue discusses the idea of removing the 'suspend delivery' button for Dash, as 'Disconnect pump' sets a zero TBR and resumes delivery automatically, questioning if there is a good use-case to keep the suspend button.
fix: The thread concludes that the 'suspend delivery' button will be removed, but the 'resume' button will remain.
evidence_quote: yes, the 'resume' button will still be there!
